cells.rationale: Deps-seam refactor on the production CLI plus a broad 1:1 translation with a contract-shaped export and the parity gate as the only net makes this the epic's contract-touching early proof point.
A byte-for-byte port against a clear reference file with an exhaustive green dual-run oracle, but the stubborn-child reaping and stdin-absorb timing subtleties keep it on opus.

Multi-part custody work introducing new patterns (frozen screens, standalone #24690-safe runner, byte-identical generator) around a subprocess/goldens contract where a wrong freeze bakes in a bad normative contract.
Config-resolution and argv wire-contract seam in keeper with fail-closed precedence, an untouched boot gate, and db.ts overlap with fn-1131 — a wrong abstraction propagates past the task.
A read-only report script over known envelope/event shapes plus a runbook doc — multi-faceted but low blast radius, reversible, and no contract surface, so it routes down to sonnet.
